description: This file defines the interface 'RequiresDistributionAndOrdering' which specifies methods for data distribution and ordering requirements during data write operations in Spark SQL connector.

classes.name: RequiresDistributionAndOrdering
classes.description: An interface for write operations that require specific data distribution and ordering.

methods.name: requiredDistribution
methods.description: Returns the distribution required by this write operation.

methods.name: distributionStrictlyRequired
methods.description: Indicates if the distribution requirement is strictly enforced.

methods.name: requiredNumPartitions
methods.description: Returns the number of partitions required for the write.

methods.name: advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes
methods.description: Provides a suggested size for shuffle partitions in bytes.

methods.name: requiredOrdering
methods.description: Returns the ordering requirements for the data during write.
